This means the source archive is not integrity-verified, which creates a supply-chain risk that a tampered or malicious binary could be installed without detection. Although the package does not execute the binary during build, the lack of a verified checksum undermines confidence in the package content.

The PKGBUILD contains no code that exfiltrates data, downloads and executes untrusted code, obfuscates commands, or tampers with unrelated system files.
